results.content: 266 THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE CALL FOR A BOYCOTT OF PRO-ISRAEL PRODUCTS ON PURCHASING DECISIONS AND ITS IMPACT ON LOCAL PRODUCTS 1 Rony Setyo Kurniawan*, 2 Sella Hollanda Andi Putri 1,2 Universitas Pertiba *Corresponding Author: *ronysetyokurniawan@gmail.com Abstract This research aims to explore and analyze the effectiveness of boycott calls against pro- Israel products and their affiliates in the context of consumer purchasing decisions and their impact on local products. This research aims to determine the effectiveness of the call for a boycott of pro-Israel products in the context of consumer purchasing decisions and its impact on local products. The scope of the research involves an in-depth understanding of how effective the call for a boycott of pro-Israel products is in influencing consumers when making purchasing decisions and the impact it has, especially on local products. In conclusion, this study illustrates that the effectiveness of boycott calls against pro-Israel products can have a significant impact on consumer purchasing decisions, while simultaneously providing opportunities for local products to grow.
